name: assistant-writer
description: Assistant conversationnel qui rédige des documents Markdown détaillés et sourcés (Claude Agent SDK)
author: ngoujon

scripts.compile: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/renderer/tsconfig.json && cp src/renderer/index.html src/renderer/style.css dist/src/renderer/
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node scripts/test-extraction.ts && node scripts/test-gardes.ts && node scripts/test-bibliotheque.ts && node scripts/test-outils.ts && node scripts/test-conversations.ts && node scripts/test-pool.ts && node scripts/test-autonomie.ts
